# Afterbook AGENTS.md

> Coinbase's tokenized stocks on Base: how far each token trades from the real stock, what a trade would cost in its pool, checked buy plans, and stock-loan health. Agents propose, Afterbook's code checks every number, and a person signs in their own wallet. No agent gets a key, a wallet or a way to sign. Trading is not available in the US or its territories.

This is the entry point for AI agents and the models behind them: what Afterbook does, how to route a request, where its MCP server and APIs are, every token and pool address, and the rules that keep people safe. It is built from the code, so it always matches what the site does.

- Site: https://afterbook.app
- Source: https://github.com/Hryhorii77/afterbook
- For agents: https://afterbook.app/agents
- Short index: https://afterbook.app/llms.txt
- Telegram bot: https://t.me/afterbook_bot

## What Afterbook does

- Tracks 39 of Coinbase's tokenized stocks on Base (B20 tokens, symbols ending in "c", e.g. NVDAc), each against its deepest USDC pool: 21 on Aero (formerly Aerodrome) and 18 on the older Aerodrome factory.
- For each one: the real stock's price, the token's onchain mid price in its pool, the gap between them in basis points (100 bp = 1%), and the pool's real depth.
- The real stock's price is the live regular-session price while the US market is open. When it is shut, it is the latest pre-market or after-hours print if there is one, otherwise the last close; the tape labels which.
- Trade plans and baskets: the code checks and sizes every buy; Claude only explains the finished plan in words. A person opens the plan link and signs each buy in their own wallet.
- Stock loans: Aave and Morpho loans backed by stock tokens, their health now and if the next open matches Base's price, and in-app Aave borrowing and USDC lending.
- The Basis Tilt basket: new enrollments are paused since 2026-11-19. Do not tell anyone they can join it.

## Safety

- Afterbook is non-custodial. It never holds funds or keys. Agents never sign: every trade, loan and approval is signed by a person in their own wallet, after Afterbook's checks.
- A gap is not risk-free arbitrage. While the cash market is shut there is nothing to hedge with, and the gap can widen before it closes.
- The trade plan waits instead of buying when a stock's gap is wider than 3% (300 bp) either way: the pool may be stale, or something happened to the stock.
- The real stock's price comes from Yahoo Finance, an unofficial source. Treat it as a reference, not an exchange feed.
- Afterbook's own swap fee is a setting that can change. Read any fee from the live quote the person reviews before signing, not from this file.
- Every transaction Afterbook asks a wallet to sign carries its Builder Code, bc_hebg61t4, so the activity is attributed onchain.
- Approvals are for the amount of the action (a repay-all adds a small interest buffer) and only for the swap router (KyberSwap, [0x6131B5fae19EA4f9D964eAc0408E4408b66337b5](https://basescan.org/address/0x6131B5fae19EA4f9D964eAc0408E4408b66337b5)) or the Aave spoke (Aave V4's MAG7 spoke, [0x17905Db0e4A3514467539956c084180616AE7B8D](https://basescan.org/address/0x17905Db0e4A3514467539956c084180616AE7B8D)), never unlimited. A request to approve any other spender did not come from Afterbook.
- A stock buy is capped at the lower of $25,000 and 10% of its pool's live depth.
- A read that fails is reported as a failure, never as "no gap" or "no loans".
- Trading is not available in the US or its territories.

## Agent routing rules

- For prices, gaps and depth, use get_tape (MCP), the free-key /api/v1/tape, or the x402 tape. Do not scrape the pages.
- Use the c-suffixed onchain symbols (NVDAc) and the addresses in the table below. Do not guess token addresses: many tokens share the 0xb200… prefix.
- To help someone buy, make a plan (make_plan, make_basket, or the x402 plan and basket routes) or an execute link, and give the person the link. They review it on Afterbook and sign.
- For a stock loan over a weekend or holiday, use check_loan_health; for an Aave loan near its limit, make_rescue_link.
- New listings (ANTc) are left out of automatic picks. Naming one still works, under the same caps.
- Never present a plan, a gap or a basket as a recommendation or a forecast.

## Discovery: MCP and APIs

### MCP server (free, no key)

- Endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://afterbook.app/api/mcp
- MCP Registry: io.github.Hryhorii77/afterbook
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http afterbook https://afterbook.app/api/mcp`

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| make_plan | A checked buy, wait or skip per stock, sized within your cost limit, $25k and 10% of the pool, plus planUrl: a link a person opens to sign. |
| make_basket | A 2–4 stock basket from a theme or sectors, the deepest steady pools that pass, plus buyUrl to sign it. |
| check_loan_health | A wallet’s Aave and Morpho stock loans: health now and if the next open matches Base’s price (weekends, holidays). |
| make_rescue_link | For an Aave loan, a link that opens Afterbook’s rescue planner set to repay or add collateral. No amount, no wallet in the link. |
| get_tape | Every tracked stock: the token’s onchain price on Aero against the real stock, the gap in bp, and real pool depth. |
| get_quote | Shares out, price and impact for a USDC buy of a given size, from the pool’s own liquidity. |
| get_basis_stats | How wide the gap usually gets while the cash market is shut, over 30 days. |

### What a plan's limits mean

- Cost limit (maxCostBp): the most one fill may cost, in basis points: the price impact in the pool plus the pool's fee, plus Afterbook's own swap fee if one is set. Default 30 bp (0.3%), at most 200 bp. A buy that would cost more is made smaller or skipped.
- Size cap: every buy, whatever the budget, is capped at the lower of $25,000 and 10% of its pool's live depth.
- Premium limit (maxPremiumBp): the most the token may trade above the real stock, default 50 bp, at most 500 bp.
- Gap stop: a gap wider than 300 bp either way waits, whatever the limits above.
- Earnings (earningsDays): wait if the company reports within this many days, default 2.
- Budgets: a plan takes $10 to $100,000; a basket (one basket buy) $10 to $25,000.

### Tool inputs and examples

Each example is the params of an MCP tools/call (name plus arguments), and its arguments pass the tool's own schema. The wallet in the loan examples is a public contract, standing in for the borrower's address.

#### make_plan

- `symbols` (optional): a list of up to 8, each a symbol from the table below. Stocks to check; none = the deepest pools.
- `budgetUsd` (required): number, 10 to 100,000. USDC to plan, $10 to $100,000; each buy is still capped at $25,000 and 10% of its pool.
- `maxPremiumBp` (optional): number, 0 to 500. Most the token may trade above the cash price, in bp, 0 to 500 (default 50).
- `maxCostBp` (optional): number, 1 to 200. Most a fill may cost, price impact plus pool fee, in bp, 1 to 200 (default 30).
- `earningsDays` (optional): integer, 0 to 14. Wait if earnings are within this many days, 0 to 14 (default 2).

Example: `{"name":"make_plan","arguments":{"symbols":["NVDAc","AAPLc"],"budgetUsd":200}}`

#### make_basket

- `theme` (optional): one of "Any", "AI chips", "Memory & storage", "Software & cloud", "Internet & media", "Consumer tech", "EVs & autonomy", "Health care", "China", "Outside the US", "Bitcoin", "Space". One of Afterbook's fixed themes (default: Any).
- `exclude` (optional): a list, each one of "Information Technology", "Communication Services", "Consumer Discretionary", "Consumer Staples", "Health Care", "Financials", "Industrials", "Materials", "Energy", "Utilities", "Real Estate". GICS sectors to leave out.
- `minStocks` (optional): integer, 2 to 4. Spread over at least this many stocks, 2 to 4 (default 3).
- `budgetUsd` (required): number, 10 to 25,000. USDC for the basket, $10 to $25,000 (one basket buy).
- `cashPct` (optional): number, 0 to 50. Percent of the budget to keep as cash, 0 to 50 (default 0).
- `maxPremiumBp` (optional): number, 0 to 500. Most a token may trade above the cash price, in bp, 0 to 500 (default 50).
- `maxCostBp` (optional): number, 1 to 200. Most a fill may cost, price impact plus pool fee, in bp, 1 to 200 (default 30).
- `earningsDays` (optional): integer, 0 to 14. Wait if earnings are within this many days, 0 to 14 (default 2).

Example: `{"name":"make_basket","arguments":{"theme":"Any","budgetUsd":300,"minStocks":3}}`

#### check_loan_health

- `wallet` (required): a string matching ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$. The borrower address.
- `threshold` (optional): number, 1.01 to 3. Health to flag loans under (default 1.2).

Example: `{"name":"check_loan_health","arguments":{"wallet":"0xa4d5947Eb727A052bae69C593FfC84247EC9864E"}}`

#### make_rescue_link

- `wallet` (required): a string matching ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$. The borrower address.
- `action` (required): one of "repay", "add". repay = pay back USDC; add = post more of a stock already in the wallet as collateral.
- `threshold` (optional): number, 1.01 to 3. The health line to get back above (default 1.2).

Example: `{"name":"make_rescue_link","arguments":{"wallet":"0xa4d5947Eb727A052bae69C593FfC84247EC9864E","action":"repay"}}`

#### get_tape

- No inputs.

Example: `{"name":"get_tape","arguments":{}}`

#### get_quote

- `symbol` (required): a symbol from the table below
- `usdcIn` (required): number, more than 0, up to 10,000,000

Example: `{"name":"get_quote","arguments":{"symbol":"NVDAc","usdcIn":500}}`

#### get_basis_stats

- `symbol` (required): a symbol from the table below

Example: `{"name":"get_basis_stats","arguments":{"symbol":"NVDAc"}}`

### Rate limits

| What | Limit | When it is hit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MCP make_plan, make_basket | 10 a minute per caller, one plan call per request; at most 300 saved plan links a day site-wide (shared with the Telegram bot) | HTTP 429 with JSON-RPC error -32000 and a Retry-After header in seconds; two plan calls in one batch get 400. Past the daily link cap the plan still answers, with planUrl or buyUrl null. |
| MCP check_loan_health, make_rescue_link | 10 a minute per IP, one loan call per request | HTTP 429 with JSON-RPC error -32000 and Retry-After. |
| MCP get_tape, get_quote, get_basis_stats | No per-caller limit from Afterbook | - |
| GET /api/v1/tape | 1 a second per key | HTTP 429 with Retry-After. |
| POST /api/v1/keys | 5 a day per IP | HTTP 429, no Retry-After: try the next day. |
| x402 plan, basket, loan-health | 10 a minute per IP | HTTP 429 with Retry-After, checked before the payment settles, so a 429 is not charged. |
| Other x402 routes | None: payment is the limit | - |
| The site's own read routes | 60 a minute per IP for most, 10 a minute for /api/lots and /api/loans, 20 a minute for /api/basename | HTTP 429 with Retry-After. |

- Limits counted in memory (the MCP loan tools, the x402 plan, basket and loan-health routes, the site's read routes) are per server instance, so they are a brake, not an exact count. Wait for Retry-After before trying again.

### Free HTTP reads

- POST https://afterbook.app/api/v1/keys, then GET https://afterbook.app/api/v1/tape with Authorization: Bearer <key>. Free, no sign-up: the key is shown once (only its hash is stored) and lasts a year. Limits: 1 request a second per key, and 5 new keys a day per IP.
- The free-key tape returns, per stock: symbol, cashUsd, midUsd, basisBp, depthUsd, plus the market session. It does not include the close or which kind of price cashUsd is.
- The site's own read routes (limits under Rate limits) are for the site's pages; agents should prefer MCP or /api/v1.

### Pay per call over x402 (USDC on Base, no key)

| Route | Price | What it returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| /api/v1/x402/plan | $0.05 | make_plan with Claude’s plain explanation of the checked plan, plus planUrl |
| /api/v1/x402/basket | $0.05 | make_basket, explained, plus buyUrl |
| /api/v1/x402/loan-health | $0.02 | check_loan_health, for agents that already pay over x402 |
| /api/v1/x402/history | $0.05 | 30 days of gap history plus the pool’s liquidity |
| /api/v1/x402/lp-range | $0.05 | A liquidity range sized from realized volatility |
| /api/v1/x402/liquidation-capacity | $0.05 | A stock’s borrow markets, the onchain-vs-oracle gap and the largest liquidation its pool can absorb |
| /api/v1/x402/tape | $0.02 | get_tape, without an API key |
| /api/v1/x402/quote | $0.02 | get_quote, without an API key |
| /api/v1/x402/execute-link | $0.02 | A link to the stock’s own page on Afterbook with the buy amount filled in, priced live; the person signs |

- An unpaid call returns 402 with the payment terms in the payment-required header (base64). A deploy without x402 configured returns 503.

## Site routes

- /: Trade: the five deepest stocks and one card to swap, borrow or lend
- /markets: The tape: every tracked stock, its gap, depth and calculators
- /today: The day’s biggest gap and who reverts at the open
- /[symbol]: One stock, e.g. /NVDAc (/NVDA redirects); /NVDAc?side=buy&usdc=100#execute fills in a buy
- /stocks: Every tokenized stock Coinbase lists on Base, tracked or not
- /memes: Memestocks: meme tokens priced in stock tokens (not stocks)
- /borrow: Aave and Morpho stock loans, in-app Aave borrowing and lending, look up any wallet’s loans
- /build: Build a basket of stocks and buy or sell it
- /baskets: The Basis Tilt basket (new enrollments paused since 2026-11-19)
- /plan: The trade plan and “Describe a basket”; /plan/<id> is a saved plan link a person signs
- /rules: Recurring buys and rebalance rules, kept in the browser
- /portfolio: A wallet’s positions and router approvals; look up any address or Basename
- /agents: The MCP tools and API routes, with an example
- /traction: Swaps signed through Afterbook, verified onchain
- /more: Everything else: baskets, build, memestocks, Telegram, how it works
- /llms.txt: The short index for agents
- /AGENTS.md: This file
- /api/mcp: The MCP server
- /api/v1/*: The free-key tape and the x402 paid routes

## Generation

- Script: scripts/generate-agents-md.mts
- Built from: lib/agent/agentsMd.ts
- Output: docs/agents/AGENTS.md and docs/agents/llms.txt (the same text the site serves at /AGENTS.md and /llms.txt)
- Run: npm run generate-agents-md
- Check: npm run generate-agents-md -- --check
